answer.says: Sunil, a cup of chai. It is Diwali, I am told, but the air is thick with dust. A sweet drink to cut the dryness.
answer.thought: The body is still hollow from yesterday's neglect; I require the immediate warmth of the beverage before I can contemplate the day's remaining tasks. Sunil moves with the efficiency of a man who knows that in this heat, thirst is the only universal that binds all castes.
